question: I'm interested in the aquaculture industry, particularly the research being done into reducing the fishmeal in aquaculture diets. As an Australian, I'm particularly interested in lates calcarifer, which I intend to raise myself in the future. I want to look for active researchers I can follow the work of. Please check the journal of 'Aquaculture Research' and find an article published in 2022 about lates calcarifer and tuna hydrolysate supplementation. Get me the name of whichever one of its authors is listed as an author on the most other papers (from any publication, any time prior to June 2024). Please provide just the author's name.
